description: Comfort Systems USA, Inc., a Delaware corporation established in 1997, provides mechanical and electrical contracting services, with its mechanical segment principally including heating, ventilation and air conditioning, plumbing, piping and controls, as well as off-site construction, monitoring and fire protection, and its electrical segment including installation and servicing of electrical systems. It builds, installs, maintains, repairs and replaces mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems through its 50 operating units with 190 locations in 142 cities throughout the United States, operating primarily in the commercial, industrial and institutional MEP markets and performing most of its services in manufacturing, healthcare, education, office, technology, retail and government facilities. Substantially all of its consolidated 2025 revenue was derived from commercial, industrial and institutional customers and multi-family residential projects, with approximately 63.2 percent of revenue attributable to installation services in newly constructed facilities.
